action: In general, a standard system update will make all the necessary changes.
description:
It was discovered that ImageMagick did not correctly handle certain images.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service or
obtain sensitive information. This issue only affected Ubuntu 16.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 18.04 LTS, Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 24.04 LTS.
(CVE-2026-56367)

It was discovered that ImageMagick did not correctly handle certain images.
An attacker could possibly use this issue to cause a denial of service.
(CVE-2026-93586)

It was discovered that ImageMagick did not correctly handle certain images.

service. This issue only affected Ubuntu 20.04 LTS, Ubuntu 22.04 LTS,
Ubuntu 24.04 LTS, and Ubuntu 26.04 LTS. (CVE-2026-93587, CVE-2026-93588)
